checks.question: What is the difference between ClusterIP and NodePort?
checks.answer:
ClusterIP exposes a Service on a cluster-internal IP, making it reachable only within the cluster; it is the default Service type. [D25]
NodePort exposes a Service on each node's IP at a static port and also sets up a cluster IP address. [D1]

checks.question: Are a StatefulSet's persistent volume claims always deleted when I delete the StatefulSet?
checks.answer: No. Retain is the default, so PVCs remain when their Pods are deleted. With whenDeleted set to Delete, PVCs from the volumeClaimTemplate are deleted after their Pods are deleted. [D10] [D10]
